s1089.literal: After Confucius had arranged the Six Classics and lectured on the banks of the Zhu and Si, he had three thousand disciples, seventy of whom mastered the Way.
s1089.idiomatic: After Confucius had arranged the Six Classics and lectured on the banks of the Zhu and Si, he had three thousand disciples, seventy of whom mastered the Way.

s1090.literal: Their responses to the Master and their private discussions and studies—words in accord with the Way—were sometimes written on their sashes and sometimes pursued without satiety.
s1090.idiomatic: Their responses to the Master and their private discussions and studies—words in accord with the Way—were sometimes written on their sashes and sometimes pursued without satiety.

s1091.literal: 仲尼既沒，遂緝而論之，謂之論語。.
s1091.idiomatic: 仲尼既沒，遂緝而論之，謂之論語。.

s1092.literal: At the beginning of Han there were Qi and Lu versions.
s1092.idiomatic: At the beginning of Han there were Qi and Lu versions.

s1093.literal: Those transmitted in Qi had twenty-two chapters; those in Lu had twenty chapters.
s1093.idiomatic: Those transmitted in Qi had twenty-two chapters; those in Lu had twenty chapters.

s1094.literal: In Qi: Wang Ji, Commandant of Changyi; Zong Qi, Director of the Palace Workshop; Gong Yu, Grand Secretary; Wulu Chongzong, Director of the Masters of Writing; Yong Sheng of Jiaodong.
s1094.idiomatic: In Qi: Wang Ji, Commandant of Changyi; Zong Qi, Director of the Palace Workshop; Gong Yu, Grand Secretary; Wulu Chongzong, Director of the Masters of Writing; Yong Sheng of Jiaodong.

s1095.literal: In Lu: Gong Fen, Commandant of Changshan; Xiahou Sheng, Director of the Palace Workshop of Changxin; Lord Wei, Marquis of Jie, father and son; Fu Qing of Lu; Xiao Wangzhi, Former General of the Vanguard; Marquis Zhang Yu of Anchang—all named their schools after it.
s1095.idiomatic: In Lu: Gong Fen, Commandant of Changshan; Xiahou Sheng, Director of the Palace Workshop of Changxin; Lord Wei, Marquis of Jie, father and son; Fu Qing of Lu; Xiao Wangzhi, Former General of the Vanguard; Marquis Zhang Yu of Anchang—all named their schools after it.

s1096.literal: 張禹本授魯論，晚講齊論，後遂合而考之，刪其煩惑。.
s1096.idiomatic: 張禹本授魯論，晚講齊論，後遂合而考之，刪其煩惑。.

s1097.literal: 除去齊論·問王、知道二篇，從魯論二十篇為定，號張侯論，當世重之。.
s1097.idiomatic: 除去齊論·問王、知道二篇，從魯論二十篇為定，號張侯論，當世重之。.

s1098.literal: The Zhou and Bao clans composed commentarial glosses; Ma Rong also composed exegesis.
s1098.idiomatic: The Zhou and Bao clans composed commentarial glosses; Ma Rong also composed exegesis.

s1099.literal: 又有古論語，與Old Text Documents同出，章句煩省，與魯論不異，唯分子張為二篇，故有二十一篇。.
s1099.idiomatic: 又有古論語，與Old Text Documents同出，章句煩省，與魯論不異，唯分子張為二篇，故有二十一篇。.
